tasks.title: Learn the 4 tones
tasks.desc: Use Pleco or YouTube to hear and repeat each tone. Practice: mā má mǎ mà.

tasks.title: Pinyin initials & finals
tasks.desc: Cover all initials (b p m f d t n l …) and finals (a o e i u ü …).

tasks.title: First 25 vocabulary words
tasks.desc: Numbers 1–10, greetings (nǐ hǎo, xièxiè, zàijiàn), yes/no, I/you/he.

tasks.title: Next 25 vocabulary words
tasks.desc: Days of the week, colors, common verbs (shì, yǒu, qù, lái).

tasks.title: HelloChinese lessons 1–3
tasks.desc: Complete the first three lessons in the app for guided tone drilling.

tasks.title: Watch a 15-min Mandarin tones video
tasks.desc: Yoyo Chinese or ChinesePod beginner episode. No subtitles for the last 5 min.

tasks.title: Weekly review — all 50 words
tasks.desc: Run your Anki deck. Aim for >80% recall before moving to Week 2.
